observations.title: queryOneShot has no production callers — background claim about request-review/request-generate is inaccurate
observations.rationale: background 節が「この経路は request-review / request-generate コマンドが使う」と述べているが、src/ 内の全 .ts ファイルを検索した結果 queryOneShot の production インポートはゼロ。request-generate は TC-013 で削除済み（prompt-skeleton-drift-guard.test.ts の TC-028 コメントで確認）、request-review は RequestReviewStep として ClaudeCodeRunner 経由で実行。受け入れ基準 3「query-one-shot 経路でも同じ 4 値が記録されることをテストで固定する」は、「QueryOneShotResult として返す（unit テスト対象）」と解釈すれば実装可能。usage.json への記録は req 4（commit-orchestrator）経由であり req 3 は戻り値レベルと解釈するのが整合的。要件や受け入れ基準の成立は妨げないが、実装前に解釈を確認することを推奨する。

observations.title: error subtype の metrics が usage.json に到達しない可能性
observations.rationale: appendInvocation は applySuccessPostPersistEffects（success path のみ）から呼ばれる。agent-runner.ts の error 分岐（810-824）は早期 return しており commit-orchestrator を経由しないため、error subtype から抽出した metrics は AgentRunResult に乗るが usage.json には記録されない可能性がある。受け入れ基準 2「success / error 双方の subtype について検証する」が「抽出のテスト（adapter 単体テスト）」なのか「usage.json への記録テスト」なのかが曖昧。素直に読めば前者（adapter テスト = 抽出検証）が意図と解せるため、ブロッキングではない。

toolResult.reason:
Designed the agent-invocation-metrics change and wrote design.md, spec.md, tasks.md under specrunner/changes/agent-invocation-metrics/ on branch feat/agent-invocation-metrics-f94950fe.

Design summary (verified against current code):
- D1: Add shared type AgentInvocationMetrics (numTurns/durationMs/durationApiMs/totalCostUsd, all optional) on src/core/port/agent-runner.ts; add invocationMetrics? to AgentRunResult; add flat optional metrics fields (with doc comments) to CommandInvocation (src/core/usage/types.ts).
- D2: Adapter (agent-runner.ts) extracts the 4 metrics from the same result message for BOTH success (:827-844 → baseResult :1029-1041) and error subtype (:810-825) via a defensive `typeof number` helper so missing fields stay undefined (never 0/null). mergeFollowUpResult spreads baseResult so metrics survive.
- D3: Metrics ride the existing appendInvocation path — executor.ts:508-520 threads runResult.invocationMetrics into StepExecutionResult; commit-orchestrator applySuccessPostPersistEffects spreads them into the CommandInvocation. Existing gate (modelUsage present) unchanged; error-subtype metrics are carried on AgentRunResult but not persisted (success-only recording), flagged as an explicit scope boundary + Open Question.
- D4: query-one-shot repurposes the turnCount placeholder into numTurns + 3 metrics (success only; zero production callers).
- D5: usage-show appends metrics when present, omits/"-" otherwise.
- D6: job-stats deriveRunStat prefers per-invocation totalCostUsd (measured), falls back to computeCostUsd (estimated) only when absent — no double counting; adds costBasis (measured/estimated/mixed/null). Unknown-model-with-totalCostUsd no longer silently dropped.
- D7: run-level turn total (turns), null when no invocation has numTurns.
- D8 (key AC #10 mechanism): new JobStatRow fields turns/costBasis are OPTIONAL so existing hand-built row literals in job-stats.test.ts still typecheck and TC-JSTATS-024/025 exact-key snapshots stay green unchanged, while deriveRunStat always populates them for real output. Summary schema left unchanged.

tasks.md: T-01 types → T-02 adapter extraction (success+error) / T-03 one-shot → T-04 executor+commit-orchestrator wiring → T-05 usage show / T-06 job stats → T-07 backward-compat + acceptance fixation + full verify. Each acceptance criterion 1–10 is mapped to a task.

One noted deviation flagged prominently (not silently applied): query-one-shot.test.ts "turnCount is undefined" placeholder test will be updated (outside AC #10's usage/job-stats protection scope) because turnCount is repurposed to numTurns.

findings.title: totalCostUsd は main work turn 分のみで follow-up ターン分のコストを欠落する
findings.rationale: agent-runner.ts はモデルUsage を reportRetry / postWorkPrompts / outputVerification の各 follow-up ターンごとに積算する（:918-929, :965-977）。一方、設計 D2 は extractedMetrics を main result 抽出箇所のみで設定し follow-up ループでは更新しない。各 query invocation の total_cost_usd はその invocation 単体のコストであるため（コメント :915-917）、D6 ロジック（totalCostUsd 存在 → modelUsage 試算をスキップ）と組み合わせると、follow-up ターンが発生したステップでは job stats の cost が実際より低くなる。request.md が「実額が得られる」と述べる目標と乖離する可能性がある。design.md の Risks / Trade-offs 節にこの既知制限を明記することで解消できる。

findings.title: TC-JSTATS-024 は新フィールド turns/costBasis を永続的に検証しない（D8 trade-off 未記録）
findings.rationale: D8 は TC-JSTATS-024 が手書きリテラルを使うため turns/costBasis を含まず、JSON.stringify で新フィールドが出力されないことで既存 exact-key チェックが通り続けることを説明している。しかし D8 の Risk 節は「実出力に含まれる」ことを新規テストで担保するとのみ述べ、TC-JSTATS-024 が実質的に row スキーマのロックとして機能しなくなる永続的なトレードオフを明示していない。AC #8/#9 の新テストがこれを補完することを design.md 内に明記すれば、将来の保守者が混乱しない。

observations.title: request.md が queryOneShot 呼び出し元を誤記（design.md で訂正済み）
observations.rationale: request.md は「この経路は request-review / request-generate コマンドが使う」と記述するが、design.md は「production caller は現状ゼロ」と正しく訂正している。src/ を grep しても queryOneShot の呼び出し元は定義ファイル自身のみ。spec / tasks への影響なし。

observations.title: extractInvocationMetrics ロジックを agent-runner.ts と query-one-shot.ts で重複実装（意図的）
observations.rationale: T-02 は extractInvocationMetrics を agent-runner.ts に定義し、T-03 は「同型にする」と述べる。設計が明示的に重複を選択しており非ブロッキング。将来的に共有 util 化の余地あり。

findings.title: totalCostUsd reflects main-work-turn only; job-stats drops follow-up turn costs when it is present
findings.rationale: extractedMetrics is set once at line 861 from the main work result. The follow-up loops (postWorkPrompts at lines 936-946, outputVerification at 984-994) ACCUMULATE token usage into extractedModelUsage but do NOT update extractedMetrics. In job-stats.ts:183, when totalCostUsd is present the entire modelUsage branch is skipped (else-if). So for any step with follow-up turns, totalCostUsd covers only the main-work-turn cost while modelUsage holds all-turn tokens — the follow-up cost is silently dropped. The existing code comment at line 933 explicitly says 'true total cost = main query + all follow queries accumulated', confirming the expected sum is not captured. Because buildRulesFollowUpPrompts injects postWorkPrompts for virtually all pipeline steps when rules files are present, this undercount applies to the vast majority of SpecRunner dogfooding runs. The design acknowledges this as a Known Limitation but the consequence is that measured cost can be less accurate than the old computeCostUsd estimate for multi-turn steps.

options.label: Accumulate totalCostUsd and numTurns from follow-up result messages in the postWorkPrompts and outputVerification loops (symmetric to modelUsage accumulation at lines 936-946)
options.consequence: totalCostUsd and numTurns in CommandInvocation reflect the full step cost/turns; job-stats cost becomes more accurate. Requires changes to two follow-up loops in agent-runner.ts.

options.label: Accept the Known Limitation as-is; strengthen CommandInvocation.totalCostUsd doc comment to warn it is main-work-turn only and may underestimate cost for multi-turn steps
options.consequence: Cost in job stats is systematically understated for steps with postWorkPrompts (most pipeline steps). The gap widens with more follow-up turns. Users may see lower cost than expected.

findings.title: numTurns underrepresents actual SDK turn count for steps with follow-up turns
findings.rationale: Same root cause as F-001. extractedMetrics.numTurns is from the main work query only. Follow-up queries (postWorkPrompts, reportRetry, outputVerification) each produce a separate SDK query with its own num_turns. The addedTurns.postWork counter tracks these extra turns but they are never added to numTurns. As a result, job stats 'turns' column can be substantially lower than actual total API turns for a step.

options.label: Accumulate num_turns from successful follow-up result messages into extractedMetrics.numTurns, symmetric to totalCostUsd accumulation in F-001 fix
options.consequence: numTurns in CommandInvocation reflects total turns across all SDK queries for the step. More accurate turn reporting in job stats.

options.label: Accept the limitation; document in CommandInvocation.numTurns that the value is main-work-turn only
options.consequence: Turn count in job stats is understated for multi-turn steps. Users comparing addedTurns metadata with job stats turns may find discrepancies.

findings.title: TC-JSTATS-024 'row keys match spec' tests a stale hand-crafted 6-field row, not the actual 8-field deriveRunStat output
findings.rationale: TC-JSTATS-024 constructs a hand-crafted JobStatRow without costBasis and turns fields, so JSON.stringify omits those keys and the 6-field assertion passes. The actual deriveRunStat function now ALWAYS sets both costBasis and turns (to a value or null), producing 8-field rows. TC-JSTATS-024's label says 'row keys match spec' but it no longer verifies the real schema. A future developer reading this test will get an incorrect, incomplete picture of the row schema. The design explicitly accepted this as a trade-off (D8), but it creates a misleading schema contract. Add a separate test that calls deriveRunStat and verifies the full 8-field schema to close the gap.

findings.title: postWorkPrompts error return lacks invocationMetrics despite extractedMetrics being available
findings.rationale: The doc comment on AgentRunResult.invocationMetrics says 'Populated by ClaudeCodeRunner for both success and error subtypes'. The main-work error return at line 826-842 correctly includes invocationMetrics: extractInvocationMetrics(errorResult...). But the postWorkPrompts error return at line 913-927 does not include invocationMetrics, even though extractedMetrics is in scope (the main work turn succeeded and set it at line 861). Fix: add invocationMetrics: extractedMetrics to the error object at line 913-927.

findings.title: Redundant as-unknown-as casts in job-stats.ts and usage-show.ts bypass TypeScript type safety on CommandInvocation fields
findings.rationale: CommandInvocation already declares totalCostUsd?: number and numTurns?: number. In job-stats.ts:182, inv is cast to { totalCostUsd?: unknown; numTurns?: unknown } — note the field type is weakened to unknown rather than number. In usage-show.ts:67, the same redundant cast is used. Both casts are unnecessary and the job-stats variant additionally loses the declared field type. Using inv.totalCostUsd and inv.numTurns directly (with the existing typeof guards) is simpler, type-safe, and avoids masking future type errors if CommandInvocation fields change.

observations.title: deriveFromJobState cannot reconstruct metrics fields — no warning in code
observations.rationale: deriveFromJobState builds CommandInvocation from JobState.StepRun. StepRun does not carry numTurns/durationMs/durationApiMs/totalCostUsd, so any entries reconstructed via this function silently lack metrics. No production callers currently; design explicitly deferred adding StepRun metrics. However, no warning is present in the function, making it a latent consistency hazard if called for repair or migration.

observations.title: Stale test description: 'turnCount is undefined (reserved for future use)' — feature shipped as numTurns
observations.rationale: turnCount is now deprecated; the feature it reserved is implemented as numTurns. The test still passes vacuously (turnCount is never set), but the description is misleading. The tasks doc called for updating this test to cover numTurns extraction/absence instead.

observations.title: Asymmetry between modelUsage (accumulated across all turns) and invocationMetrics (main turn only) is undocumented in the follow-up loops
observations.rationale: The follow-up loops accumulate modelUsage (lines 936-946, 984-994) but do not update extractedMetrics. This deliberate asymmetry — the root of F-001 and F-002 — has no inline comment. Adding a note in the follow-up success branches would help future maintainers understand why the parallel extraction is intentionally absent.

toolResult.reason: 5件の修正を完了。HIGH(F-001/F-002): costUsdをcomputeCostUsd試算のみに戻し、measuredCostUsd(totalCostUsd総和)を独立列として追加 — follow-up turnコスト脱落を解消。LOW(F-004): postWorkPrompts errロ return に invocationMetrics: extractedMetrics を追加。LOW(F-005): usage-show.ts の as unknown as キャストを除去しinv.numTurns等を直接参照。MEDIUM(F-003): TC-JSTATS-024bを追加しderiveRunStatの実8フィールドスキーマを固定。types.tsのdoc comment にmain-work-queryのみ・follow-up不含を明記。全10212テスト green、typecheck green。spec.md/tasks.mdはcode-fixerの書き込み保護により更新不可(canon path)。

findings.title: costUsd not changed to measured-first per AC #7 and design D6
findings.rationale: AC #7 requires costUsd to use totalCostUsd (measured) when available, falling back to computeCostUsd (estimate). Design D6 specified per-invocation if/else priority logic and a costBasis field. The implementation instead keeps costUsd as always the pricing-table estimate (unchanged from pre-feature behavior) and adds measuredCostUsd as a parallel independent field. No costBasis field exists. TC-010 explicitly documents this as the intended design: 'costUsd uses computeCostUsd(modelUsage) independent of totalCostUsd.' The change was driven by the iteration-1 F-001 finding that a measured-first costUsd would exclude follow-up turn costs, making it LESS accurate than the estimate for multi-turn steps. No existing invariant is broken (costUsd behavior is preserved), but AC #7 is not honored and costBasis is absent from the JSON output schema.

options.label: Accept current design (parallel columns)
options.consequence: costUsd remains the pricing-table estimate (all-turn accurate via modelUsage), measuredCostUsd is the SDK-measured main-work-only value. AC #7 as written is not satisfied. costBasis field is absent. Consumers needing measured cost read measuredCostUsd. Update design.md D6 and tasks.md T-06 to reflect the parallel-column approach.

options.label: Implement AC #7 as written (measured-first costUsd with costBasis)
options.consequence: costUsd switches to totalCostUsd when available, computeCostUsd as fallback per invocation. costBasis added to JobStatRow. Inherits the known limitation that follow-up turn costs are excluded when totalCostUsd is present (documented in design Risks as Known Limitation). measuredCostUsd field would be removed or kept as alias.

findings.title: TC-JSTATS-024 title 'row keys match spec' tests stale 6-field schema, creating two conflicting schema authorities
findings.rationale: TC-JSTATS-024 uses a hand-crafted JobStatRow (without measuredCostUsd or turns) and asserts the JSON row has exactly 6 keys. The real deriveRunStat output has 8 keys (confirmed by TC-JSTATS-024b added in this iteration). TC-JSTATS-024's label implies it is the definitive schema gate, but it tests a hand-crafted row that bypasses deriveRunStat and cannot detect new fields. TC-JSTATS-024b closes the correctness gap but the two tests now create two parallel schema authorities with different key counts and no indication of which is authoritative. Fix: rename TC-JSTATS-024 to clarify it tests the hand-crafted 6-field row (pre-optional-fields form), not the complete schema.

observations.title: extractInvocationMetrics spreads undefined-keyed fields into CommandInvocation
observations.rationale: extractInvocationMetrics returns an object with explicit undefined values for absent fields (e.g. { numTurns: undefined, ... }). The spread ...(invocationMetrics ?? {}) includes these keys at runtime, but JSON.stringify omits undefined-valued keys so usage.json correctly stores only fields with real values. Behavior is correct but subtle — the spread object has more keys than what is persisted.

observations.title: Summary aggregation does not include measuredCostUsd or turns (intentional per D8)
observations.rationale: buildJobStatsReport.summary aggregates only costUsd (pricing-table estimate), not measuredCostUsd or turns. Per D8 ('summary schema は変えない'), this is intentional. However consumers who want total measured costs or total turns must sum the per-run rows manually. The table shows SDK $ and Turns per run but the summary footer has no corresponding aggregate.

observations.title: Inconsistent null checks: != null vs !== null for measuredCostUsd vs costUsd in table renderer
observations.rationale: renderJobStatsTable uses r.measuredCostUsd != null (catches both null and undefined) but r.costUsd !== null (catches only null). Since costUsd is a required field and cannot be undefined, both work correctly. The inconsistency is harmless but slightly uneven.

observations.title: totalCostUsd doc comment's 'all-turn via modelUsage' guidance is incomplete for unknown models
observations.rationale: The doc comment on CommandInvocation.totalCostUsd correctly states 'For all-turn cost, use modelUsage with computeCostUsd — modelUsage accumulates all turns.' However for unknown-model runs (e.g. claude-opus-5), computeCostUsd returns null, making totalCostUsd the only available cost value even though it covers main-work turn only. Documentation gap, not a code defect.
